name: openpixo/chibi-cute
title: Chibi cute
description: Rounded, tiny heroes and cheerful props with expressive faces and soft colors.

description_i18n.en: Rounded, tiny heroes and cheerful props with expressive faces and soft colors.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用圆润比例、鲜活表情和柔和色彩，塑造迷你英雄与可爱道具。

examples.title: Tiny mushroom ranger
examples.prompt: Generate a friendly mushroom ranger mascot using the chibi-cute art style, with a rounded green cape, tiny boots and an oversized acorn pouch. Keep the face expressive and the pose readable.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 chibi-cute 美术风格生成友好的蘑菇巡林员吉祥物：圆润绿披风、小靴子和大橡果腰包。让面部表情鲜明，姿态清晰易读。

examples.title: Cozy quest rewards
examples.prompt: Create six matching quest reward icons using the chibi-cute art style: star cookie, ribbon medal, seed pouch, tiny watering can, heart gem and folded map. Use rounded silhouettes and soft highlights.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 chibi-cute 美术风格制作六枚配套任务奖励图标：星形饼干、缎带奖章、种子袋、小浇水壶、爱心宝石和折叠地图。使用圆润轮廓与柔和高光。

style.prompt: Cute original chibi game artwork with a two-and-a-half-head body proportion, rounded hands and feet, simple expressive facial features and a large readable head silhouette. Soft candy colors from the shared palette, clean rounded contours, one gentle shadow shape and tiny controlled highlights. Keep accessories oversized enough to read without clutter.
style.negativePrompt: realistic anatomy, sharp aggressive proportions, detailed skin pores, complex tiny ornament, heavy dark shading, harsh neon, glossy plastic render, text, watermark

constraints.outline: Soft rounded contour in a dark muted palette color.
